_about: Robert Bruce (1554-1631), minister of Edinburgh: Sermons, ed. William Cunningham (Wodrow Society, 1843), including the Sermons on the Sacrament (1590). Named robert-bruce so the king of the same name cannot be mistaken for him. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

bruce-sermons-wodrow: Sermons by the Rev. Robert Bruce, with collections for his life by Robert Wodrow, ed. William Cunningham (Wodrow Society, Edinburgh, 1843)
